summary: Frontend e2e of the GENERALISED CRM Master Price-List import wizard with /app/test_samples/acme_name_only.xlsx (4 cols, no code column). All headline features verified visually + via DOM: per-sheet confidence badge ('70% match') data-testid=plw-confidence-Catalogue-2026, name-keyed note in sheet label, warning panel data-testid=plw-warnings-Catalogue-2026 ('No product-code column detected — a SKU will be generated from each product name.'), and Preview reaches with exactly 3 TOTAL/3 READY/0 WARNINGS/0 ERRORS/3 NEW PRODUCTS/3 MISSING SAGE CODE. AI suggest fields (plw-ai-suggest) and AI auto-detect layout (plw-ai-analyze) both fire, no error toasts, and AI auto-detect renders an 'AI: ...' explanation snippet on the sheet card. ONE caveat noted (see below): after AI auto-detect, Col A 'Item' showed '— keep as imported data —' instead of being mapped to Product name as the spec wording suggested.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'AI auto-detect layout' on the acme_name_only.xlsx sheet, the Col A 'Item' mapping cell shows '— keep as imported data —'. The deterministic engine had already set Col A → Product name (visible immediately after upload). The 'AI suggest fields' click in between also kept it mapped to 'Product name'. The subsequent aiAnalyze appears to RESET column→field mappings (only the 'AI:' explanation note is added). Spec says column 1 'Item' should map to the 'name' CRM field after AI auto-detect. The AI: note ('Simple four-column fitness product list with no SKU column, using product name as the key, trade price and RRP, all prices ex-VAT.') confirms the LLM understood the layout, but the column_mappings from the AI response are either not being merged into the sheet mapping state, or the AI response did not include column_mappings[0]='name' for this sheet. (Backend agent-to-agent note claimed 'AI added col1->name mapping', so most likely a frontend merge issue.)

action_items: Main agent: investigate CRMPriceListImportWizard.aiAnalyze() — ensure the LLM's column_mappings (e.g. {0:'name'}) are merged into the per-sheet mapping state so Col A 'Item' becomes mapped to 'Product name' after AI auto-detect, instead of resetting to '— keep as imported data —'. Verify ai-analyze API response actually includes column_mappings for the acme sheet; if backend omits, fix backend; if backend returns it, fix frontend merge.
critical_code_review_comments: Mapping reset behaviour after aiAnalyze should be confirmed: if the LLM returns no column_mappings, the wizard should at minimum PRESERVE the previous mapping (deterministic + manual + previous AI suggest). Today it appears to overwrite — losing context the user already had.

Spec UX nit: warnings panel is good, but the warning shows the same SKU-generation text twice (once in the warnings panel and once via the 'name-keyed' note next to the sheet label). Consider deduplicating to reduce visual noise.
Confidence badge (70%) is visible and useful; could also be colour-coded by threshold (green ≥80, amber 60-79, red <60) — currently a neutral pill.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only request; backend curl verified by main agent already)
success_rate.frontend: 95% — all required UI features render correctly; one regression in AI auto-detect's mapping merge.

seed_data_creation: 3 new products will be added to the master catalogue if the green 'Import 3 products' button is clicked (Preview step was reached but Import button was NOT clicked in this run to keep run idempotent — spec said 'You MAY commit it', so leaving uncommitted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workflow verified: /crm login (placeholder you@gym.com, admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123!) → /crm?tab=settings → [data-testid=settings-tab-products] → [data-testid=products-import-wizard-btn] → set /app/test_samples/acme_name_only.xlsx on [data-testid=plw-file-input] → mapping step auto-shows. [data-testid=plw-confidence-Catalogue-2026]='70% match'. Warnings panel [data-testid=plw-warnings-Catalogue-2026] shows SKU-generation warning. Sheet label shows '· name-keyed'. [data-testid=plw-ai-suggest-Catalogue-2026] and [data-testid=plw-ai-analyze-Catalogue-2026] both work (~10-20s LLM latency, no error toasts). [data-testid=plw-to-preview] reaches preview step with 3/3/0/0 (rows/ready/warn/err). KNOWN ISSUE: aiAnalyze appears to clear column→field mappings (Col A reverts to 'keep as imported data') even though the AI explanation note is added. Verify whether ai-analyze API response includes column_mappings and whether frontend merges them. Use [data-testid=plw-file-input] (NOT products-csv-input). Do NOT use the 2.7MB pulse_master_price_list_sample.xlsx — it 413s at ingress.
rca of the issue: Reproduce: login → settings → products → open wizard → upload acme_name_only.xlsx → wait for mapping step → click [data-testid=plw-ai-suggest-Catalogue-2026] (Col A becomes 'Product name') → then click [data-testid=plw-ai-analyze-Catalogue-2026] → after ~15s Col A reverts to '— keep as imported data —'. Likely root cause: aiAnalyze() in CRMPriceListImportWizard.js refreshes the sheet structure from the AI response but does not merge ai_response.column_mappings into per-sheet column→CRM-field state, or backend ai-analyze response omits column_mappings for this layout. Mitigation: after applying AI auto-detect, iterate the returned column_mappings and update mapping[sheet_name][col_index] just like the existing aiSuggest() flow does.
